title: Naik apa?
blurb: Buses, trains and tickets — and missing the one you wanted.

staff.label: Abg
staff.name: A stranger at the bus stop

notes.title: tumpang tanya
notes.body: Tumpang tanya — “may I ask?” — is the polite way to stop a stranger with a question.

notes.title: naik, turun, tukar
notes.body: Naik bas / LRT = get on, take. Turun = get off. Tukar bas = change buses.

I think I've lost my ticket.
tr.Awak kat pintu depan ke pintu belakang?: Are you at the front gate or the back gate?
A red top. I'm in front of the lobby.
tr.Baru je pergi. Kena tunggu lima belas mi: It only just left. You'll have to wait fifteen minutes.
tr.Belum. Nak beli kat mana?: Not yet. Where do I buy one?
tr.Boleh berhenti kat bank kejap?: Can we stop at a bank for a moment?
Sure. But don't be too long.
Yes. I'm in front of the lobby.
tr.Guard tak bagi masuk. Macam mana?: The guard won't let me in. What now?
The back roads are badly jammed.
The back roads. The highway is jammed.
tr.Kena tukar bas dua kali. Okay ke?: You have to change buses twice. Is that okay?
tr.Lapangan terbang. Sempat tak?: The airport. Will we make it?
tr.Leceh la. LRT ada tak?: What a hassle. Is there an LRT?
tr.Lepas lampu isyarat, belok mana?: After the traffic lights, which way do I turn?
tr.Nak bayar macam mana?: How do you want to pay?
tr.Nak beli berapa tiket?: How many tickets do you want to buy?
tr.Nak berhenti kat mana?: Where do you want to stop?
tr.Nak ikut highway ke jalan dalam?: Shall I take the highway or the back roads?
tr.Nak masuk ikut pintu mana?: Which gate do you want to go in by?
The back gate. Near the lobby.
The back gate. The front gate is jammed.
My house is next to the shop.
tr.Saya dah terlepas simpang. Macam mana?: I've missed the turning. What now?
tr.Sempat tak sampai sebelum pukul sembilan: Will we make it before nine?
Not for long. Get out quickly.
I don't think so. The road is jammed.
Never mind, I'll walk to the front gate.
Never mind. You can U-turn just ahead.
The one next to the shop.

dialogue.ms: Okay.

dialogue.ms: Bang, tumpang tanya. Mana satu bas ni pegi downtown?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, may I ask? Which of these buses goes downtown?

dialogue.ms: Bas nombor lima. Tapi baru je pergi.
dialogue.en: Bus number five. But it only just left.

dialogue.ms: Alamak. Saya terlepas bas.
dialogue.en: Oh no. I missed the bus.

dialogue.ms: Takpe. Lagi lima belas minit ada lagi satu.
dialogue.en: Never mind. There's another one in fifteen minutes.

dialogue.ms: Saya harap bas datang segera.
dialogue.en: I hope the bus comes soon.

dialogue.ms: Kalau nak cepat, naik LRT. Stesen dekat je.
dialogue.en: If you're in a hurry, take the LRT. The station is close.

dialogue.ms: Di mana stesen metro?
dialogue.en: Where is the metro station?

dialogue.ms: Jalan terus, lepas tu belok kiri.
dialogue.en: Go straight, then turn left.

wrong: I changed my bus ticket twice.

listen.ms: Awak perlu turun di perhentian berikutnya.
listen.en: You need to get off at the next stop.

listen.ms: Bas berhenti di hadapan rumah saya.
listen.en: The bus stops in front of my house.
wrong: The bus doesn't stop near my house.
The bus stop is behind my house.

listen.ms: Dari mana awak menaiki bas ini?
listen.en: Where did you get on this bus?

read.right: Baru je pergi. Kena tunggu lima belas minit.
read.why: Has it gone? Only just — and the wait.

read.en: I haven't paid for the ticket yet.

wrong: Jalan terus, lepas tu belok kiri.
read.why: No ticket yet, so ask where to buy one.

dialogue.ms: Bang, tumpang tanya. Mana satu bas ni pegi downtown?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, may I ask? Which of these buses goes downtown?

dialogue.ms: Bas nombor lima. Tapi baru je pergi.
dialogue.en: Bus number five. But it only just left.

dialogue.ms: Saya terlepas bas. Bas lain ada tak?
dialogue.en: I missed the bus. Is there another bus?

dialogue.ms: Ada, tapi kena tukar bas dua kali.
dialogue.en: There is, but you have to change buses twice.

dialogue.ms: Leceh la macam tu.
dialogue.en: That's such a hassle.

dialogue.ms: Kalau nak senang, naik LRT. Sekali je, tak payah tukar.
dialogue.en: If you want it easy, take the LRT. Just one ride, no changing.

dialogue.ms: Di mana stesen metro?
dialogue.en: Where is the metro station?

dialogue.ms: Dekat je. Lintas jalan ni, lepas tu jalan terus lima minit.
dialogue.en: It's close. Cross this road, then walk straight for five minutes.

dialogue.ms: Okay. Eh, kejap. Aku rasa tiket aku dah hilang.
dialogue.en: Okay. Oh, hang on. I think I've lost my ticket.

dialogue.ms: Takpe. Kat stesen boleh beli tiket.
dialogue.en: Never mind. You can buy a ticket at the station.

dialogue.ms: Okay. Terima kasih, bang.
dialogue.en: Okay. Thank you.

gist.q: Why does she choose the LRT?
options: The other bus means changing twice
She has an LRT ticket already
gist.why: Kena tukar bas dua kali … naik LRT. Sekali je, tak payah tukar.

read.ms: Saya perlu menukar bas dua kali.

read.right: Aku rasa tiket aku dah hilang.
